the effects of ceramic membrane channel structure and its optimization.

the effects of the wall thickness, sheltering, and interfering on the flux of ceramic membrane channels were all confirmed.
the flux of ceramic membrane module was increased by enhancing loading densities and reducing wall thickness, and the effect of loading density on flux is more obvious than that of wall thickness.

, when mean pore size of ceramic membrane was less than 200nm, flow by volume was increased by enhancing loading capacity.

the flow by volume is the most important parameter in the ceramic membrane process, and the flow by volume can be increased by enhancing loading rate.
